transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-12-31
Start: 09:30 PST
Duration: ~52 minutes
Attendees: Lena Torres (AE), Marcus Li (SE), Priya Nair (PM), Anika Bose (Eng Mgr), Ravi Shah (Infra), Elena Park (SRE)

Summary:
Quick sync to validate launch readiness for Q1 features (dedicated GA, improved batching/kv cache, private deploy runbook), triage outstanding reliability items from last incident review, align rollout/canary plan and owners. Focus on perf numbers, security signoffs, and final test windows.

Topics:
- Dedicated GA readiness and autoscale policies
- KV/prefix cache persistence and warmup
- Quantization/throughput tradeoffs for common seq length (256/512)
- Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) checklist and KMS verification
- Rollout plan: canary, A/B, fallback model variants
- Incident follow-ups and regression criteria

Transcript:
[00:00] Lena: ok hey everyone, thanks for joining the end of year, uh, end of quarter sweep, um we're about 52 minutes. we'll go through the checklist and then call out owners. Marcus, can you start with dedicated GA status?
[00:18] Marcus: yeah sure. so dedicated, last week we validated the scheduling change, the autoscaler now respects reserved pools and burst is limited to 2x for tier1. p95 latency improved with continuous batching enabled, though we saw a small regress on p50 for short uu requests, probably because of batching thresholds. the numbers are in the bench sheet I uploaded to drive.
[00:42] Anika: quick q, the p95 you mentioned was on the 8x A100 cluster or the smaller 4x? I think that matters for customer SLAs.
[01:01] Marcus: right, that was on 8x A100 equivalent, simulated load with a mixed seq distribution. On 4x the throughput is about 60% but latency profiles hold if we lower batch size. noted to add both sheets.
[01:18] Priya: ok, can we get a hosted vs dedicated cost per token estimate at p95 for the common seq lengths? Marketing wants a short blurb for launch.
[01:30] Marcus: yes I'll add a cost column. I'll include quantized runs too — int8 gives about 1.6x throughput but we need to call out small quality checks.
[01:48] Elena: on the KV cache side, the on-prem package had one regression where cache persistence wasn't rehydrating after node restart. Ravi is looking into it, but we should lock a test to prove warmup times.
[02:02] Ravi: yeah that's the issue — the config path for persistence was accidentally not mounted in the container image we shipped to staging. fixed locally, but need image rebuild and e2e test. estimated fix + test by next week.
[02:20] Marcus: good catch. I want to measure cold vs warm prefix cache impact on short dialogs too; even with caching, the initial token penalty is high for cold start.
[02:38] Anika: and that feeds into rollout decisions — if warmup is long we want canary to be sticky so early users don't hit the cold penalty repeatedly.
[02:50] Priya: yep, so proposed rollout: day0 canary at 1% traffic for 24h, if p95 within acceptance and error rate under threshold then 10% for 48h, then 50% for 72h, then full. fallback policy to hosted variant if latency or errors exceed thresholds.
[03:12] Lena: sounds reasonable. define acceptance thresholds please.
[03:18] Priya: acceptance: p95 latency <= 550ms for short seqs, under 1.5x baseline for long seqs, error rate < 0.5%, and top-k quality regression < 2% on our eval set.
[03:36] Marcus: caveat: quantized models might show slightly higher hallucination for certain prompts; we should tie quality regression to a fixed prompt set and have an auto rollback if regression spikes.
[03:52] Elena: on security, where are we with KMS/HSM integration for private deployments? SOC2 artifacts?
[03:59] Ravi: KMS integration is done for vault-backed flows but we still need HSM validation for the on-prem package. SOC2 stuff — controls doc is updated but audit window is in Jan. I'll share the doc link after the meeting.
[04:14] Lena: action, share security doc and SOC2 snapshot with PMs and customer success. also confirm SSO, SAML and RBAC flows in private control plane.
[04:25] Priya: regarding the on-prem checklist, we need a runbook for network cutover and failure modes. also, does the telemetry pipeline handle masked tokens appropriately? we should ensure no PII leaks.
[04:40] Ravi: telemetry masks at agent level but we'll add an audit pass by SRE to validate.
[04:46] Anika: incident follow-ups — the last incident (mid-Dec) identified a cascading retry loop when fallback models hit capacity. any mitigation work?
[04:58] Marcus: we implemented request throttling and smarter fallthrough routing to alternate variants. but we need to validate under high-concurrency synthetic tests. I'll run the scenario in staging with simulated cross-region failover.
[05:15] Priya: schedule: we want final sign-off from Eng, SRE, Security by 2027-01-12 to keep launch timeline. QA window is 2027-01-04 to 2027-01-08.
[05:26] Elena: note — QA needs a stable seeding of prompts. Anika, can you own seeding the regression suite?
[05:32] Anika: yes, I'll own that. I'll include top-200 prompts and the edge cases from the incident.
[05:40] Lena: ok cool. anything else on infra?
[05:43] Ravi: one more: KV cache persistence option adds ~200MB per node in metadata. need an infra sizing note in the docs so Dedicated pricing reflects it.
[05:55] Marcus: noted, will add to the cost spreadsheet.
[06:00] Priya: about monitoring and alerts — need to surface token-level cost spikes per route in the console for SREs. can we have a dashboard snapshot for the launch?
[06:12] Marcus: yes, will prepare a few GA dashboards (p50/p95/p99, cost per token, batch size distribution).
[06:22] Lena: last thing — legal needs a list of third-party deps for the on-prem build; also we mentioned Anthropic and AzureML benchmarks in the doc, double-check competitors section before release.
[06:36] Priya: I'll scrub the doc and keep the comparative bench language conservative.
[06:42] Lena: recap and owners then. Marcus — perf & cost sheet + staging failover test by 2027-01-07. Priya — finalize canary plan + doc scrub by 2027-01-05. Ravi — KV cache persistence fix + KMS/HSM validation + SOC2 snippet by 2027-01-10. Anika — regression prompt suite and coordinate QA window by 2027-01-04. Lena — circulate launch checklist and confirm sign-offs by 2027-01-03.
[07:08] Anika: one minor note, let's add a pre-launch on-call overlap for the first 48 hours post-launch.
[07:14] Elena: agree, SRE will rotate and monitor metrics and HQ alerts.
[07:18] Lena: perfect. thanks everyone, we'll meet again early Jan if any of these slip. happy new year, and let's get the checklist green.

End of transcript.
